target_customer: Professionals and teams who spend heavy time in email and calendar
problem: Email and calendar admin consumes hours of knowledge workers' time and inbox tools do not act on their behalf.
business_model: Consumer and prosumer SaaS subscription with a 30 day free trial
product_category: AI native email client and AI secretary

founders.name: Archit Mehta
education: Cornell, graduated at age 20 per YC page
previous_startups: PPE price tracker built in high school, reached 50,000 users (name not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page also says he led 50 students building mobile apps with 10,000 plus daily users at Cornell.

technical_complexity.rationale: A full email client with LLM drafting in the user's voice, labels, memory and mobile apps is a large surface, but built on third party models and mail APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI email clients and overlays exist and Gmail added free AI drafting in January 2025, so features are easy to copy and users can switch clients.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Gmail made AI drafting free in January 2025 and Microsoft followed; Grammarly acquired Superhuman in October 2025 per a search snippet.

market_need_then: Heavy email load and LLM drafting made AI inbox tools a hot category in early 2025. The product launched on YC with a year of free access for signups within one week (2025-02).

branding.domain_note: Uses stampmail.ai because plain stamp domains are taken; another YC company is also called Stamp (veterinary admin).

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise short lines such as Email, handled.

branding.brand_signature: Cursor for Email positioning at launch

rebrands.why: Positioning change visible between the 2025 YC launch and the 2026-03-31 Product Hunt launch; not explained

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch on 2026-03-31 reached 160 upvotes and placed seventh of the day.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic real word that collides with unrelated stamp products in search and with another YC Stamp; modest Product Hunt result and no brand press.

pivots.from: Cursor for Email, an AI native email client
pivots.to: AI secretary for email and calendar with mobile app and voice mode
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from changed launch titles, so treat as a positioning shift

outcome_analysis: Stamp is a one person Winter 2025 YC company building an AI native email client that later repositioned as an AI secretary for email and calendar with mobile apps. There is no exit or shutdown news. It competes with Gmail, Superhuman, Shortwave and Fyxer in a category where incumbents added AI features quickly, and no verified funding or revenue was found.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, Caplight, EveryDev) report 500K USD pre-seed announced 2025-03 with YC as investor and an unverified 7M valuation; no round recorded. A Product Hunt aggregator names Vin Bui as a cofounder who met Archit at Cornell, but the YC page and company site do not, so he is not listed. Competitor search found only 2026 comparison pieces and the Gmail AI drafting January 2025 mention, so the dated competitor list is empty. The pivot and rebrand rows are inferred from titles and may overstate the change.
